entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I think I need to make a return? I'm a little confused about how it all works. I have this helmet I bought a while ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, let me see... yes, it's VF-8675309. I ordered it for my nephew, but it's just been sitting here. I get so overwhelmed with online shopping.
No problem at all. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, placed on October 30th. So you've had it for about 58 days. What seems to be the issue with it?

Fifty-eight days? Oh my. It's just... the color wasn't right for him. I meant to send it back sooner, but I got confused by the emails. The box is completely unopened, I never even touched it. Can't you just help me? I don't understand the policy.
I understand it can be confusing. Let me just double-check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. It looks like you're still well within our 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. Since the box is unopened, the process will be very simple. It's a shame about the color, as that specific helmet has our highest safety rating. But we want you to be happy with your purchase.
Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so easy.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
